QUOTE: "The 0xFF80 mask selects the high-level module (bits 7–15). The low 7 bits (`0x007F`) are the low-level module." and "**Combined codes.** A single return can carry both parts, for example an SSL code plus a low-level cause. The output is `"HIGH : LOW"`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer describes the two-layer code (high-level module bits and low-level bits) and states that mbedtls_strerror outputs both joined with " : " when both are present.
